correctness.rationale: Prime-to-five involution quotient isogeny identifies the five-divisible groups with a square of a genus-two Jacobian. The exact genus-two Cartier matrix has determinant Phi. The reciprocal quartic quadratic discriminant gives the smooth locus; substitution v=n/d gives precisely six distinct removed points and uniform extension-field count. At (-1,2), the Hasse matrix squares to zero, giving the genus-two p-rank zero and a=1, hence genus-four p-rank zero and a=2 via the prime-to-p isogeny. Standalone program exhausts F5, F25, F125 (13/1,553/19,15253/121). Computations are independent spot checks; symbolic proof covers all m.

value.rationale: The nonordinary Hasse stratum is a natural arithmetic invariant of a distinguished nontrivial genus-four square-Jacobian family. Its exact reduced rational geometry, four rational plus one quadratic Frobenius puncture, and extension-field counts are coherent structural information not a routine isolated parameter check; it does not claim all Newton polygons.
